The only per-caption settings are text, position, size, color, and style. No traced image paths, screenshot backgrounds, or per-line widths are used in the recreations.


How the comparison is measured
The source and render stay at the same 1080 × 1920 coordinates. There is no automatic image registration or alignment that could hide placement errors. Crop mode only changes the viewing window. The overlay combines the original and the live recreation; the difference image comes from the saved Chrome capture. A perfect difference image would be black.
